import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import sys

run = Path(sys.argv[1])
candidates = (
    "dense_6979__allmask_cardinality_balanced_erm",
    "dmome_6979__two_stage_allmask_cardinality_balanced_mofe",
    "dmome_6979__two_stage_allmask_cardinality_balanced_mofe_cagrad",
)
ordinals = (0, 4, 5)
expected = {
    candidates[0]: (400, 0, False),
    candidates[1]: (400, 0, True),
    candidates[2]: (1300, 300, True),
}
selected = {
    f"task_{context * 6 + ordinal:03d}": (candidate, context)
    for context in range(24)
    for candidate, ordinal in zip(candidates, ordinals)
}
attempt_paths = sorted((run / "attempts").glob("task_*.json"))
result_paths = sorted((run / "results").glob("task_*/result.json"))
error_paths = sorted((run / "results").glob("task_*/error.json"))
if (
    {path.stem for path in attempt_paths} != set(selected)
    or {path.parent.name for path in result_paths} != set(selected)
    or len(attempt_paths) != 72
    or len(result_paths) != 72
    or error_paths
):
    raise SystemExit("recovery authority is not exactly 72 attempts/results and zero errors")

uuids = set()
counts = {candidate: 0 for candidate in candidates}
for task_id, (candidate, context) in selected.items():
    task = json.loads((run / "tasks" / f"{task_id}.json").read_text())
    attempt = json.loads((run / "attempts" / f"{task_id}.json").read_text())
    result = json.loads((run / "results" / task_id / "result.json").read_text())
    if (
        task.get("task_id") != task_id
        or task.get("candidate_id") != candidate
        or task.get("context_ordinal") != context
        or attempt.get("task_id") != task_id
        or attempt.get("scientific_fit_attempt") != 1
        or result.get("task_id") != task_id
        or result.get("candidate_id") != candidate
        or result.get("attempt_uuid_v4") != attempt.get("attempt_uuid_v4")
        or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f-]{36}", str(attempt.get("attempt_uuid_v4")))
    ):
        raise SystemExit(f"selected task/attempt/result lineage changed: {task_id}")
    uuid = attempt["attempt_uuid_v4"]
    if uuid in uuids:
        raise SystemExit("duplicate attempt UUID in recovery authority")
    uuids.add(uuid)
    training = result.get("training_result", {})
    gradients, solves, staged = expected[candidate]
    if (
        result.get("optimizer_updates") != 400
        or training.get("updates") != 400
        or training.get("training_model_forward_calls") != 400
        or training.get("checkpoint_model_forward_calls") != 400
        or training.get("parameter_gradient_traversals") != gradients
        or training.get("cagrad_solver_calls") != solves
        or training.get("outer_feature_loads") != 1
        or training.get("outer_label_reads") != 1
        or training.get("outer_model_forward_calls") != 1
        or training.get("outer_evaluator_calls") != 1
        or (training.get("stage_one_model_state_sha256") is not None) != staged
        or (training.get("stage_one_optimizer_state_sha256") is not None) != staged
    ):
        raise SystemExit(f"selected fit accounting changed: {task_id}")
    counts[candidate] += 1

status = json.loads((run / "runtime" / "status.json").read_text())
if (
    status.get("state_counts")
    != {
        "ambiguous": 0,
        "completed": 72,
        "failed": 0,
        "interrupted": 0,
        "pending": 180,
    }
    or status.get("completed_by_gpu") != [18, 18, 18, 18]
    or status.get("valid_terminal_candidate") is not True
